condition.description: Clinical quality and value-based care reporting module. Covers patients with qualifying encounters. Stub module (7c): condition_id is a module name, not a clinical condition; boolean aggregation expressed as a degenerate single-pathway use case.

eligibility_criteria.description: At least two qualifying encounters within the past 24 months.

variable_pathways.derivation_rule: Degenerate single-pathway (boolean) case: return primary_pass if encounter_date_primary satisfies pass_criterion, else no_valid_pathway. Any check FAIL fails the only pathway.

remediation_defaults.action_required: Normalize encounter_date values to YYYYMMDD at the interface layer. Auto-normalize unambiguous formats (e.g., MM/DD/YYYY); flag ambiguous transpositions and impossible dates for source-system lookup or clinical confirmation.

output_definition.primary_output: Boolean readiness flag per patient for clinical quality and VBC reporting.
